reviews.text: St Francis Dispensary are a definite god send . The staff are simply wonderful and so knowledgeable. I travel from Ashbourne to Inchicore regularly with my elderly dogs for vaccinations, dental surgeries , Arthritis treatments and a cancer surgery. I always feel assured my pets are in the best place receiving the best treatments and wouldn’t dream of taking my pets anywhere else. Update 29/09/2026 I would like to send my Gratitude to Amanda who has sadly returned home to Norway for all of the wonderful care she has given our Dogs Precious & Louie and our cats Miso & Kuro. Amanda , Julia, Aoife , Clare, Emma & Pauline ( sorry if I missed anyone out ) are the most kind & caring veterinarians it has ever been my pleasure to meet. I also wish to give a most special thank you to Emma & Julia for easing Precious’ suffering and helping us all to say a final goodbye . They allowed us all of the time we needed with Precious before passed and afterwards and we will be forever grateful for their patience , reassurance and understanding at a very difficult time in our lives .

I have been going to this practice for 18 years and have recommended this practice to a lot of people.,ive never had  a bad experience until today. I brought my 17yr old cat here today.Granted I knew she was ill but did not realise how ill. The vet Julia was very straight and to the point but by god was she rude! She told me snappy was very ill with a number of complaints and when i tried to figure out how this all happened so quickly i was met with this has been happening a while which it had not.And eye infection was neglect which I attended the practice for and was told there was nothing more could be done for it except bathe.Granted there was extra pus but this was only 2 days until I could get an appointment. I was made to feel like i did not take care for her. The young man who was with me and ive spoken to tonight..asked her what she meant neglect,that I had taken great care of her.He said i was upset and did not hear the word neglect thats why he pointed it out She has a ragged coat but I thought it was old age and was never mentioned at previous visits! I asked what was best for my cat and she said uthnesia very matters of factly. Everything was matter of fact no empathy at all for the situation that was happening and all very rushed. As she said they had appointment after appointment!  Which i can understand but im also paying for a service and in a time of loosing your pet/best friend was not appropriate.Never will I let any pet go to her again i will continue to use this service as ive never encountered bad practice/ rudeness  like this before The rest of the staff are very understanding and nice.
Thank you to the lovely Team at St Francis's for looking after our little Rosie.
Always feel like my dog Theo is in safe hands.

We never had such a bad experience with vet before.. extremely rude vet Julia, very old school and superficial. There is no point of trying to search for the cause, your dog just has to get injections for the rest of his life and that's it. You have a sensitive dog and you have to live with it. That's the comment we got. Examination was very shallow, with no affection what's so ever. Just the worst experience ever for 120 euro. Not recommending and not coming back.
